name: typed_pdf_exists_clean_match_1
description: Real, genuine W-9 PDF (Apex Industrial Supplies LLC) -- 'flattened' fillable-PDF pattern (AcroForm widgets empty, values baked into the text stream after the page footer, disconnected from labels; also multi-page, so the footer marker repeats once per page). Tax classification (LLC) is resolved via checkbox-widget position matching, not the flattened text alone -- see extraction/flattened_form.py. Matches an existing supplier exactly: no diffs. Note: tax_classification.llc_subclass is deliberately NOT asserted here -- it differs by which extractor actually runs (see decision/pipeline.py's Azure-first branching): the free LayoutOCRExtractor path finds 'C' via a PyMuPDF text-stream quirk specific to this fixture, but visual inspection confirmed that value was never actually rendered on the page at a legible position, so Azure Document Intelligence (OCR on the rendered page) honestly returns null for it -- a real, documented finding, not a bug in either extractor (see docs/design_doc.md §3.3).

name: typed_pdf_exists_clean_match_2
description: Same flattened/multi-page PDF pattern as above, second real document (Global Tech Solutions Inc.). Tax classification is S-corporation -- deliberately worth asserting explicitly, since a plausible-looking guess from the entity name alone ('...Inc.' implying C-corp) would have been wrong; only the checkbox-position detection gets this right. Matches an existing supplier exactly: no diffs.

name: typed_pdf_exists_address_changed
description: Same flattened/multi-page PDF pattern as the two clean-match cases above, third real document (NorthStar Office Equipment LLC). Fills a gap the other two PDF cases didn't cover: matches an existing supplier by TIN, but the street address on file (data/supplier_master.csv) is deliberately stale ('4050 Market Center Drive' vs the document's real '4100 Market Center Drive') -> UPDATE_EXISTING with a field diff -- the PDF-path equivalent of the two image-based 'address changed' cases below, which until now were the only ones exercising this scenario.

name: photo_supplier_does_not_exist_1
description: Real photographed/scanned W-9 (Green Earth Services Partnership) via live Azure Document Intelligence extraction. Not on file for this tenant at all -> CREATE_NEW. SKIPPED if Azure isn't configured (the pipeline raises AzureNotConfiguredError for any image-format document with no fallback -- see decision/pipeline.py).

name: photo_supplier_does_not_exist_2
description: Real photographed/scanned W-9 (BrightPath Consulting) via live Azure Document Intelligence extraction. Not on file -> CREATE_NEW. SKIPPED if Azure isn't configured.

name: handwritten_supplier_exists_info_changed_1
description: Real handwritten W-9 (Sunrise Medical Devices LLC) via live Azure Document Intelligence extraction. Matches an existing supplier by TIN, but the street address on file is stale -> UPDATE_EXISTING with a field diff. SKIPPED if Azure isn't configured.

name: handwritten_supplier_exists_info_changed_2
description: Real handwritten W-9 (Metro Construction Supply Inc.) via live Azure Document Intelligence extraction. Regression case: the earlier vision-LLM provider (GPT-4o) read this document's checked 'Partnership' box as 'C Corporation' with self-reported confidence 1.0 -- caught only because it produced a field_diff against this supplier's existing record, which wouldn't have happened for a brand-new supplier (see docs/design_doc.md). The tax_classification assertion below is the regression test for the fix: Document Intelligence's selection-mark detection, not a language model's guess. Also matches an existing supplier by TIN with a stale street address on file -> UPDATE_EXISTING with a field diff. SKIPPED if Azure isn't configured.
